title: Write a Deployment Step | Orchard Core
description:
A deployment plan exports configuration and content as a package, using the steps that Orchard Core and its modules provide. A module that keeps its own data needs a deployment step of its own.

A deployment step is a class that a plan stores, a source that adds recipe steps and files to the package, a display driver with its views, and one registration. This video reads how the All Features step is written, then adds that step to a plan and follows the package it builds.

In this video:
• How a deployment plan becomes a package
• The step: Name, Category and Title
• The source: recipe steps and files
• The editor: a display driver and its views
• The registration in a startup class
• The step in a plan
• The package and its recipe step
